description: Banque Carrefour des Entreprises (CBE) is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by FOD Economie. The Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (CBE) is a database of the FPS Economy in which all basic data of companies and their business units are collected. Coverage: FOD Economie. The portal shows the English title as "Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (CBE)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is FOD Economie. Its keywords include Onderneming, FOD Economie, Vestiging. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
